name: Love and Rockets
label: Beggars Banquet
lede: Three-quarters of Bauhaus named themselves after a comic book, made psychedelic pop for American college radio, and then Daniel Ash wrote 'So Alive' in a studio basement in about an hour and took it to No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

hero.by: Love and Rockets at Lollapalooza, August 3, 2008. Photo: Scott Penner, Wikimedia Commons

eras.title: Bauhaus minus the singer
eras.text: When Bauhaus ended in July 1983, Daniel Ash and Kevin Haskins carried on in Tones on Tail and David J went solo. By 1985 the three of them were a band again, without Peter Murphy and without the black clothes.

years.h: Ash, David J and Haskins borrow a name from a comic
years.p: The trio takes its name from Love and Rockets, the comic series by the Hernandez brothers. [[David J|41225e9f-3b4c-4287-a778-165c65f04be9]] and Kevin Haskins are brothers too.

years.src: Wikipedia: Seventh Dream of Teenage Heaven · Wikipedia: Love and Rockets
years.h: The first single is a Temptations cover, 'Ball of Confusion'
years.p: Released on Beggars Banquet as a stand-alone single, it later went to No. 18 in Canada.

years.src: Wikipedia: Seventh Dream of Teenage Heaven
years.h: Seventh Dream of Teenage Heaven, recorded in Leamington Spa
years.p: The band co-produces with John A. Rivers at Woodbine Studios. AllMusic later compared it to the lauded trips of the original psychedelic era.

eras.title: College radio falls for them
eras.text: At home the band stayed small. In North America, college stations and modern rock radio picked them up record by record, and the Bauhaus association faded behind acoustic guitars and pop hooks.

years.cap: Ash outside the Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, June 1986
years.h: Express brings 'Yin and Yang (The Flowerpot Man)'
years.p: The second album leans harder into pop, and its dance track 'Yin and Yang (The Flowerpot Man)' is the club hit.

years.src: Wikipedia: Earth, Sun, Moon · Songfacts: Daniel Ash
years.h: 'No New Tale to Tell' is the song that opens America
years.p: Earth, Sun, Moon swaps gloom for acoustic, folky psychedelia, and 'No New Tale to Tell' reaches No. 18 on the US Mainstream Rock chart.
years.xp: Derek "Guru" Tompkins co-produced with the band. 'Mirror People' came out again in 1988 as a punched-up single; Ash says he wrote it about clubgoers in Columbus, Ohio, who couldn't stop admiring themselves in the mirrors while they danced.

years.h: The band becomes the Bubblemen for a novelty single
years.p: 'The Bubblemen Are Coming' comes out on Beggars Banquet under the alias, with its own video.

eras.title: Two chords and a bottle of whiskey
eras.text: Recording at Blackwing in south-east London with John Fryer, the band made the record that turned it into a Top 40 act in America. The single that did it was written in one morning and sold almost nothing at home.

years.h: Ash writes 'So Alive' in Blackwing's basement in under two hours
years.p: Two days after seeing a woman at a party in Northampton, Ash takes an acoustic guitar and a bottle of whiskey down to the studio cellar and comes back up with the song.
years.xp:
Ash told SPIN he had two chords and one line on the Monday morning: "I got to record it today." Fryer brought in three backing singers, who were each paid £75. Ash told Songfacts the model was 'Walk on the Wild Side'.

He was newly married, and has said he never got close enough to the woman to speak to her.

years.h: The self-titled album becomes their best seller in America
years.p: Recorded mostly at Blackwing in 1988, it goes platinum in Canada. 'Motorcycle', 'Rock & Roll Babylon' and 'No Big Deal' are the other singles.

years.big: "Screw the indie world. I like commercial success."
q: Screw the indie world. I like commercial success.
years.src: SPIN · Wikipedia: Love and Rockets (album) · Wikipedia: Love and Rockets
years.h: 'So Alive' goes to No. 3 in the US and sells 600 copies in the UK
years.p: No Bauhaus-related act had been near the Billboard Hot 100 top ten. 'So Alive' also spends five weeks at No. 1 on the Modern Rock chart.
years.xp: Ash told SPIN the American label was so sure of the song that it printed "including the hit single" on the sleeve before release. In Britain, he says, it sold about 600 copies.

years.src: Wikipedia: Love and Rockets (album) · Houston Press
years.h: A world tour on the back of a hit, then five years apart
years.p: After the long tour for Love and Rockets, Ash and David J make solo records instead of a follow-up.

eras.title: Rubin, an ambient turn and a fire
eras.text: The band came back sounding like The Orb, lost its American label and signed to Rick Rubin's American Recordings. Then the house it was living and recording in burned down, and the album that came out of the ashes had a burnt guitar on the cover.

years.h: Fans return Hot Trip to Heaven to the shops
years.p: Beggars Banquet keeps them in the UK; in the US it's American Recordings. Ash heard of buyers taking the CD back, saying "This isn't Love and Rockets."
years.xp: The band wrote without guitars at first, aiming at the ambient dance of [[The Orb|42c14c80-bd17-47e4-9bb2-a35897638c4d]] and [[Orbital|f3e2a7d9-c6bb-4848-95e5-04c0a1e2f511]]. Neither single charted, and the album peaked at No. 49 on CMJ's alternative radio chart.

years.cap: The burnt guitar on the cover of Sweet F.A.
years.src: Houston Press · Rock and Roll Globe · Love and Rockets Bandcamp · Wikipedia: Love and Rockets · BrooklynVegan
years.h: Fire guts the American Recordings house where the band lives
years.p: Every piece of gear and months of tapes are lost. David J jumps from a second-floor window unhurt; visiting friend Genesis P-Orridge jumps from another and cracks ribs.
years.xp:
The Houston Press describes the place as Rubin's Los Angeles home; the band's Bandcamp calls it Rubin's mansion. The only recording saved was 'Ritual Radio', an 18-minute piece Kevin Haskins had taken home. Ash's burnt Fernandes guitar was pulled from the debris and photographed for the cover.

Wikipedia says the band then fought the label and the insurer in court and was found not responsible. In 2023 David J called the record "the Phoenix rising from both the literal and figurative flames."

years.src: Beggars Banquet: Sweet F.A. · Houston Press
years.h: Sweet F.A. comes out on American Recordings
years.p: Rebuilt from scratch, it's a return to guitars under Rubin's guidance. Beggars Banquet settled on March 18, 1996, as the most likely release date.

years.h: Lift, on Red Ant
years.p: The seventh album comes out on Red Ant Records.

years.cap: Ash at the Guvernment, Toronto, on the farewell tour, 1999
years.h: A last show in Toronto, fifteen years in
years.p: Love and Rockets play Toronto and then stop.

eras.title: Joe Strummer gets them back
eras.text: A tribute night for Joe Strummer put the three back on a stage, and a run of festivals followed. Then Ash said he wanted to work with other people.

years.h: 'Should I Stay or Should I Go', twice, at the Key Club
years.p: The band reunites for Cast a Long Shadow, a Joe Strummer tribute in West Hollywood, and plays [[The Clash|8f92558c-2baa-4758-8c38-615519e9deda]] song two times.

years.cap: Love and Rockets on stage at Coachella, Indio, April 27, 2008
years.h: Coachella in April, Lollapalooza in August
years.p: Love and Rockets play the Coachella festival, then Lollapalooza in Chicago's Grant Park on August 3.

years.h: "I really want to work with new people"
years.p: Ash says the three have worked together since 1980 and he's done. In August, New Tales to Tell arrives, a tribute album with [[The Flaming Lips|1f43d76f-8edf-44f6-aaf1-b65f05ad9402]], [[Frank Black|98a35a4d-a845-4282-bc7c-5679f2bb9bd2]] and Puscifer.

eras.title: Fifteen years, then Pasadena
eras.text: Bauhaus was finished for good, and a festival offer and a Beggars reissue campaign landed at the same time. Love and Rockets toured more in 2023 than in the previous 24 years.

years.cap: Daniel Ash at Cruel World, Pasadena, May 2023
years.src: Slicing Up Eyeballs · Wikipedia: Love and Rockets
years.h: Cruel World in Pasadena, the first show in 15 years
years.p: Ash told Slicing Up Eyeballs the reunion came "out of the blue": Beggars was planning vinyl reissues just as the festival made Haskins an offer. Sixteen shows followed into June.
years.xp: In the same interview Ash called Bauhaus "signed, sealed and delivered. All done." He also said this tour would be Love and Rockets' last.

years.cap: David J and Kevin Haskins at Kings Theatre, Brooklyn, June 2023
years.h: Sweet F.A. returns with a Genesis P-Orridge track
years.p: Beggars Arkive reissues the album, remastered at Abbey Road, alongside My Dark Twin, a double CD of session outtakes including 'U. O. ME' with P-Orridge.

years.h: A Jane's Addiction fight ends the tour Love and Rockets was opening
years.p: The North American tour with [[Jane's Addiction|e3434cc7-d348-491a-9dc8-325af3d9086d]] is cancelled midway after Perry Farrell clashes with Dave Navarro on stage in Boston.
